explanation: Compared against OEIS A234360 conjecture (ii): if n > 3, then k(k+1)^{φ(n−k)/2} − 1 is prime for some 0 < k < n. The file encodes 'k(k+1)^{φ/2} − 1 = p' as (p+1)² = k²(k+1)^{φ(n−k)}. That is equivalent when φ(n−k) is even, and when φ(n−k) = 1 (n−k ≤ 2) it correctly requires k(k+1)^{1/2} to be an integer, avoiding natural-number division of the exponent. Faithful.
